prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: JI RAN'S OFFICE. Sleek, spacious contemporary executive office of a design company, in warm walnut, white and grey. A large walnut desk is covered with architectural plans, wood samples, a metal figurine and a pour-over coffee station. Behind it stands a black leather executive chair. To one side are a lounge area of black leather sofas and armchairs around a white marble coffee table, and a wall sign reading 'JUST DO IT'. The door is on the side wall facing the desk, with open space in front of the desk for standing visitors. Floor-to-ceiling windows behind the desk let in bright, soft daylight from behind and to the left of the desk. Warm recessed ceiling spots and a brass desk lamp fill in from above.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
